\begin{document}
In the noncentrosymmetric superconductor the singlet gap $\Delta_s$ and the triplet gap $\Delta_p$ mix, and the
two helicity bands carry the gaps
\begin{equation}
\Delta_\pm \equiv \Delta_s \pm \Delta_p .
\label{eq:gaps}
\end{equation}
Their difference measures the triplet admixture,
\begin{equation}
\Delta_+ - \Delta_- = 2\Delta_p ,
\label{eq:diff}
\end{equation}
and their product is
\begin{equation}
\Delta_+\Delta_- = \Delta_s^2 - \Delta_p^2 .
\label{eq:prod}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
